correction.prior_claim: presence reactor was a live process but had no systemd unit because archie-presence.service was not found
correction.corrected_claim: the checked unit name was incomplete; the existing canonical unit is archie-presence-reactor.service

failed_intervention_preserved.event: A new archie-presence.service was temporarily installed under the mistaken assumption that no presence unit existed.
failed_intervention_preserved.observable_counterexample: The existing archie-presence-reactor.service immediately restarted the killed old reactor, producing two presence_reactor.py processes and two bound Unix datagram socket inodes at the same pathname.
failed_intervention_preserved.repair: The newly created duplicate archie-presence.service was disabled and removed. The existing canonical archie-presence-reactor.service was kept. Final court observed exactly one matching reactor process and one socket owner.
